predecessors.name: Qing dynasty
predecessors.text: 'Leased to France: 29 May 1898'; occupied by France on 22 April 1898

successors.name: Republic of China
successors.text: 'The territory was formally ceded to the Republic of China on August 18, 1945'; the French flag 'was lowered for the last time on November 20, 1945'

ledger.x: 29 May 1898: infobox 'Occupied by France: April 22, 1898' and 'Leased to France: 29 May 1898'; 'the Treaty of May 29, 1898, ratified by China on January 5, 1900', a 99-year lease.

18 August 1945: 'The territory was formally ceded to the Republic of China on August 18, 1945' (a convention between the Provisional Government of the French Republic and the National Government of China); the French flag was lowered 'for the last time on November 20, 1945'.

certainty.note: Fixed by the 1898 treaty, but no page gives the line; the radius is a stand-in within 17 percent of the page's 1,300 km2.
